key_insight: MedCheckpoint uses knowledge-grounded agents, locked study designs, and deterministic statistical tools to make automated drug-safety analyses more consistent and auditable.
clinical_relevance: The system could support postmarketing drug-safety research, but its performance on real-world clinical data remains unestablished.
method: Ground analytical stages in a curated, source-traceable medical knowledge base.
Lock core study-design parameters and analyze patient-level data with human-written statistical tools.
Abort infeasible analyses through checkpoints, with optional human review.
evidence_signal: On 54 questions using simulated EHRs for 2.7 million individuals, MedCheckpoint outperformed two coding-agent baselines in LLM-rated report quality and consistency, with no misleading failures across seven stress-test trap questions.
watch_item: Evaluation relied on simulated EHRs and LLM judges; real-world validation and independent expert assessment are needed.
paper_title: Automating postmarketing pharmacovigilance with large language model agents
